formula: p_i = exp(logprob_i - max_logprob) / sum_j exp(logprob_j - max_logprob). H=-sum_i p_i log(p_i); effective support=exp(H), with inverse sum p_i^2 also reported. Total variation from the greedy point mass is exactly1-p_greedy.
aggregation_note: Statistics weight tasks/pools equally. Singleton pools are reported separately through the non-singleton summary. Expectations are analytical; no random candidate draw or training data change was performed.

interpretation.what_is_exact: Temperature1 softmax is the precisely normalized distribution of the stored reference path likelihoods restricted to each explicitly enumerated finite candidate set, subject to the already-recorded numerical/model prompt protocol. It is not a probability estimate over unenumerated successful paths.
interpretation.greedy_gap: Greedy is a point-mass/MAP choice. This audit measures how much finite-pool probability it discards, not an estimate of downstream learning effects. Higher entropy and1-max_mass imply potentially different supervision under a hypothetical conditional draw.
interpretation.projection_limit: The proposed pool is a deterministic, privileged recipe subset with original-success and canonical length/cost restrictions. Its normalized likelihoods do not correct candidate proposal bias, establish full successful-path support, implement MH, or establish the original distribution-projection objective. Different endpoint states are explicitly allowed.
interpretation.scope: No development results were consulted; these calculations do not authorize sampling, temperature changes, another method or additional evaluation.
